self_audit: Full equal-gray connected zones include level0 and every singleton; weighted global/per-gray counts recover the quantized input population.
Visited marking and FIFO append commit on one edge before the next neighbor read; each pixel enqueued once, so head/tail/size<=N and CW represents N without wrap.
Axial/diagonal candidates require x and row bounds before synchronous RAM read; no border wrap or outside pixels.
Source/visited capture covers all N locations; FIFO current-zone prefix is written before read; all padded histogram entries clear after reset and final result retirement.
All dense fields held under backpressure; first accepted tag owns malformed fixed-N capture; independent SOF/EOL errors gate every count and global zones to0.
Independent global edge union/root-size histogram predicts output; exact tails and scan/pop/neighbor/inbounds/zone totals checked for every main frame.
Maximum square numerical NOT_RUN fixed before tools; no timeout, fixture shrink, retry, synthesis, PnR, STA, board or expanded regression.
